answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 23032 Country: United Kingdom Title: I did istikhara for marriage, i had a dream about the person being in my house being happy with my sister and there were two babies one of my sisters and the other im not too sure. my mum was there too. i saw myself with him in a petrol station also he bought me a wedding ring which i didnt like. what could this mean? Question: I did istikhara for marriage, i had a dream about the person being in my house being happy with my sister and there were two babies one of my sisters and the other im not too sure. my mum was there too. i saw myself with him in a petrol station also he bought me a wedding ring which i didnt like. what could this mean? Answer ID: 23032 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1269/955/H=1431) If you feel disheartened after istikhara it means that the proposal is not suitable for you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
